Projects

  • Math RL: Can PPO Use a Cheaper Critic?

    A reinforcement learning research project exploring lightweight linear critics for training math-solving language models. It reuses the model’s hidden representations to compare ridge regression and least-squares temporal-difference critics against conventional PPO and GRPO, evaluating both accuracy and training compute.

  • Awesome-ZK: Zero Knowledge On-Ramp

    A practical introduction to zero-knowledge proofs for developers, combining conceptual and mathematical primers with hands-on Cairo examples and an ERC-20 implementation. It includes testing, JavaScript integrations, and a few case studies to connect the fundamentals to real applications.
